stops.name: Wimbachklamm Gorge
stops.quote: Wimbachklamm Gorge offers an unforgettable nature experience along bridges and wooden walkways.
stops.english: Wimbachklamm Gorge offers an unforgettable nature experience along bridges and wooden walkways.

stops.name: Wimbach Valley
stops.quote: Nestled between Mount Watzmann and Mount Hochkalter at the entrance to Wimbach Valley, you'll discover one of the region's most impressive natural landmarks.
stops.english: Nestled between Mount Watzmann and Mount Hochkalter at the entrance to Wimbach Valley, you'll discover one of the region's most impressive natural landmarks.

stops.name: Ramsau
stops.quote: At the entrance to the vast high-alpine valley between Mount Watzmann and Mount Hochkalter, near the mountaineering village of Ramsau, lies the narrow Wimbachklamm Gorge.
stops.english: At the entrance to the vast high-alpine valley between Mount Watzmann and Mount Hochkalter, near the mountaineering village of Ramsau, lies the narrow Wimbachklamm Gorge.

stops.name: Wimbachgries
stops.quote: While the upper Wimbachtal valley, known as Wimbachgries, is covered in dry gravel and the water flows underground, the mountain stream bursts back to the surface in Wimbachklamm Gorge.
stops.english: While the upper Wimbachtal valley, known as Wimbachgries, is covered in dry gravel and the water flows underground, the mountain stream bursts back to the surface in Wimbachklamm Gorge.

stops.name: Berchtesgaden National Park
stops.quote: Wimbachklamm Gorge in Berchtesgaden National Park is a fascinating geological attraction, a spectacular natural landmark, and a popular destination for hikers and walkers alike.
stops.english: Wimbachklamm Gorge in Berchtesgaden National Park is a fascinating geological attraction, a spectacular natural landmark, and a popular destination for hikers and walkers alike.

stops.name: Wimbachschloss
stops.quote: Once a hunting lodge belonging to the Wittelsbach royal family, it now welcomes hikers as a mountain restaurant in Berchtesgaden National Park.
stops.english: Once a hunting lodge belonging to the Wittelsbach royal family, it now welcomes hikers as a mountain restaurant in Berchtesgaden National Park.

stops.name: Wimbachgrieshütte
stops.quote: Farther up Wimbachtal, Wimbachgrieshütte offers overnight accommodations and is a popular destination for hikers and mountaineers.
stops.english: Farther up Wimbachtal, Wimbachgrieshütte offers overnight accommodations and is a popular destination for hikers and mountaineers.
